typical_root_causes: Authentication endpoint (SSH, RDP, SMB, Web Login) exposed directly to untrusted WAN without rate-limiting

Legacy insecure protocol enabled (e.g., Telnet, unencrypted FTP, unauthenticated RDP)

Legitimate user experiencing keyboard mapping issue or repeated password typos
Internal vulnerability scan conducted by authorized SecOps audit team

recommended_actions.name: Temporary Target Account Lockout
